lessons.title: Why the first weeks feel hard
lessons.body: SSRIs often cause early side effects before mood benefit. Educational counselling: set expectations, ask about crisis support — Materia does not publish titration numbers here.

lessons.title: Serotonergic combinations
lessons.body: Fluoxetine–tramadol teaching is about escalating serotonin toxicity risk to the clinician, not inventing a switch. Confirm against current SA guidance and the labelled products.
